name: YuXin Little Magic 5x5
description: The Yuxin Little Magic 5x5 M is a great magnetic 5x5 speed cube for those on a budget. Despite its economical price, the Little Magic 5x5’s performance is not compromised with a medium magnetic feel and smooth turning out of the box. Also featuring bright stickerless shades, this puzzle is likely to become very popular very quickly.
